citation: Hughes MCB et al. Sunscreen and prevention of skin aging
main_result: 24% less progression of blinded microtopographic aging; relative odds 0.76 (95% CI 0.59-0.98)
current_routine_item: Round Lab SPF 50 for outdoor exposure
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Exact product UVA protection use amount reapplication and current exposure differ

citation: Castanedo-Cazares JP et al. Near-visible light and UV photoprotection in melasma
intervention_and_parameters: SPF 50+ UV plus visible-light protection with iron oxides and 4% hydroquinone
main_result: Greater improvement in melasma and color measures with visible-light protection
current_routine_item: Round Lab SPF 50; tint status unknown
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Melasma population hydroquinone co-treatment and visible-light context do not establish universal tint need

citation: Sitohang IBS et al. Topical tretinoin for treating photoaging
design: Systematic review of randomized controlled trials
intervention_and_parameters: Topical tretinoin 0.025% to 5% for 3 to 24 months
main_result: Consistent clinical photoaging improvements; heterogeneous formulas outcomes and older studies
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Tretinoin evidence cannot be assigned directly to adapalene or stacked into a Tria course

citation: Tran QT et al. Adapalene cream 0.1% in female skin ageing
intervention_and_parameters: Adapalene cream 0.1% plus common cleanser moisturizer and sunscreen
comparator: No active treatment plus common background care
main_result: Main skin-aging score improved more; one objective pigment score did not significantly separate; early stinging and xerosis common
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Small study no vehicle control female-only population and current Tria schedule limit transfer

citation: Huang CY et al. Comparative efficacy of pharmacological acne treatments
population_or_scope: 221 RCTs; 65,601 participants in main lesion-count analysis; 37 interventions
main_result: Oral isotretinoin ranked highest overall; topical retinoid plus BPO combinations were among stronger topical strategies
applicability_to_current_routine: Strong category but unknown personal fit
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: No current acne diagnosis lesion type severity baseline or outcome; adding BPO is not automatically warranted

citation: Reynolds RV et al. Guidelines of care for acne vulgaris
population_or_scope: Systematic evidence review for acne management
intervention_and_parameters: Topical retinoids and benzoyl peroxide strongly recommended; azelaic acid conditionally recommended
comparator: Multiple classes and standards of care
applicability_to_current_routine: Good class alignment if acne is active
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Guideline evidence is diagnosis-specific and does not define safe Tria combination timing

citation: Zelickson BD et al. Home-use nonablative fractional laser for wrinkle reduction
intervention_and_parameters: PaloVia 1410 +/- 5 nm; daily active phase then twice-weekly maintenance
main_result: Reported investigator and subject improvement through maintenance
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Different device wavelength geometry schedule and endpoint; uncontrolled design prevents effect attribution

citation: Geronemus R et al. Treatment system with a 1440 nm fractional nonablative laser
design: Evaluator-blinded randomized split-face study; laser given to the entire face
population_or_scope: 49 women enrolled; 43 completed main 12-week treatment phase
intervention_and_parameters: Tria 1440 nm whole face at least 5 times weekly for 12 weeks plus antioxidant system on one randomized side
comparator: Laser alone on the contralateral side
main_result: Both sides improved from baseline; randomized comparison favored the adjunct for selected endpoints
current_routine_item: Tria 1440 nm at least 5 times weekly for 12 weeks
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: No untreated or sham-laser control; strongly industry-linked; no Tria-versus-professional comparison

citation: Bragato EF et al. PBM application frequency in facial rejuvenation
intervention_and_parameters: 660 +/- 10 nm mask; 6.4 mW/cm2; 8.05 J/cm2; 21 minutes; 2 or 3 sessions weekly
main_result: Selected image-derived wrinkle lengths and satisfaction favored active; main wrinkle scale did not separate; no meaningful 2-versus-3 weekly difference
current_routine_item: PL300 red and NIR whole-body panel used 10 minutes daily
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Facial geometry wavelength mix treatment-plane irradiance fluence and weekly cadence are unverified

citation: Photobiomodulation reduces periocular wrinkle volume by 30 percent
intervention_and_parameters: Defined red and amber facial PBM protocols; 10 sessions over 4 weeks; 3.8 J/cm2
main_result: Reported periocular wrinkle-volume reduction under the studied protocol
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Named local facial protocol cannot validate a high-output full-body panel schedule

citation: King S et al. Azelaic acid for acne rosacea melasma and skin aging

main_result: Evidence supported indication-specific acne rosacea and melasma use; no eligible skin-aging trial
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: 10% finished formula is not represented by the dominant concentration evidence and the current diagnosis is unspecified

intervention_and_parameters: Varied topical vitamin C formulas and protocols
main_result: Signals for smoother less-wrinkled skin and pigment lightening; hydration improved similarly to placebo; ideal concentration unknown
main_evidence_to_practice_gap: Exact formula form pH packaging stability oxidation status and endpoint are unknown
